title: Concept: CORS allows every request header
description: A preflight response accepted every request header. A wildcard allow-list removes the server's chance to reject a header it never expected, so any header the application reads for routing or trust becomes caller-controlled for origins the policy admits. The finding is the missing restriction, not a demonstrated cross-origin read.
applicability: APIs that answer CORS preflight requests.
risk: Caller-controlled headers on admitted origins; LOW severity.
